_comment: THE subject list. It was a literal inside scripts/cohort.py, which meant a subject could only
be added by editing the program that measures subjects. Intake needs to add one without a
human opening an editor, so the list moved out here and the program reads it.
affiliation is PER SUBJECT and it is not decoration. `same_owner` says the subject and the
verifier's owner are the same person; without it these first rows would read as independent
verifications, which they are not. An applicant who arrives through /apply/ is NOT the
operator, so their passport must not carry it -- stamping the constant onto everyone would
understate every external verdict and, worse, would let a self-verification hide among them.
source records where the row came from. `intake:<id>` is the KV key's uuid, so any published
verdict can be traced back to the request that asked for it.
